description:
Where ``notify_team`` (and ``escalate_to_human``) posts a summary for the team (V5-25).

The webhook URL is a secret: it is kept in an ``http-tool-secret`` key under
``secret_name`` and reaches the worker resolved, never in the stored config.

credential_id.description: An `http-tool-secret` key holding the webhook URL
credential_id.title: Credential Id

include_transcript.description: Add the recent conversation to the message. Off by default: a transcript may hold personal details.
include_transcript.title: Include Transcript

on_escalation.description: Also post when the agent escalates the call to a person
on_escalation.title: On Escalation

secret_name.description: The name the webhook URL is stored under in that key
secret_name.title: Secret Name

style.description: `slack` posts a Slack message; `generic` posts JSON fields
style.title: Style

title: NotifyTeamConfig
